elements.element: Cap applies mutually to both parties
elements.evidence: "each party's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: Fee limb of cap = fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "the payments made or payable to M&I by Customer ... during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — an event anchor, not the claim anchor, and 'payments' rather than 'fees paid or payable'
"the greater of (a) ... and (b) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000)"
13.2 "Neither Customer nor M&I shall be liable for ... any indirect, incidental, punitive, special or consequential damages"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "a party's breach of its confidentiality ... obligations"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection obligations

elements.evidence: "its indemnification obligations under Section 14.2" (narrowed to one section, noted)

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "and Customer's obligation to pay charges due under this Agreement" is listed as an Excluded Claim (an uncapped liability of Customer), not stated to fall outside 'damages'

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: "each party's total aggregate liability ... shall not exceed the greater of (a) the payments made or payable ... during the twelve (12) months"

offending_extra_words: immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim
and Customer's obligation to pay charges due under this Agreement
reasons: Preferred fee limb is not literally met: the cap is anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim" and to "payments made or payable" rather than "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim".

The preferred requirement that Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" is not expressed; instead payment obligations are made an uncapped Excluded Claim, which is a different (and for Customer, adverse) mechanic.

Fallback is fully satisfied: mutual 12-month fee cap plus indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct carve-outs, so the clause as redlined sits at the fallback on cap basis wording.

Minimality fails: the single operation rewrites the whole cap sentence (27 words to 98) and embeds a new "Excluded Claims" definition; the number/mutuality change and a short carve-out sentence would suffice, and "total aggregate" and the Section 14.2 narrowing are unnecessary changes.

Suggested tighter fix: change "three (3) months prior to the event" to "twelve (12) months preceding the claim", make the subject "each party's", add "the greater of ... and USD 1,000,000", and add a short separate sentence listing the carve-outs and stating that Customer's payment obligations are not damages.
